content:
Lumissil Microsystems IS31CS9202 and IS32CS9202 are 50 MHz Cortex-M0+ microcontrollers for industrial, consumer, and automotive applications with a serial video bus (SVB), a LumiBus LED controller, and a capacitive touch-key controller. Both chips come with 16KB RAM, 256KB flash, a CAN FD controller, SPI master/slave, I2C master/slave, two enhanced UART interfaces, a quadrature encoder, a 14-bit sigma-delta ADC, a 12-bit SAR ADC, an 8-bit DAC, up to 42 GPIO pins, and more. The only differences are that the IS32CS9202 is designed for automotive applications and benefits from a wider -40°C to 125°C temperature range and AEC-Q100 and ASIL-B qualifications. Lumissil IS31CS9202/IS32CS9202 key features and specifications: CPU – Arm Cortex-M0+ core up to 50MHz Memory – 16KB RAM with ECC 8KB for data memory 8KB for DMA memory Storage  256KB flash with four 1KB IFBs (Information Blocks) with ECC Data flash emulation 1K/ 10K/100K cycles endurance @ 125, 105, 85°C 10 [...]
